extension.description: NextGen RT Films Kodi Plugin. Browse and stream RT Documentary films directly in Kodi. Watch free documentary films on war, history, nature and more. Automatic updates available via repository.
extension.disclaimer: This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by RT (Russia Today). It simply provides a convenient way to access publicly available RT content within Kodi. Users are responsible for ensuring their use complies with RT's terms of service and local regulations.
